name: browser_base
description: Generic single-page browser primitives for Laya workflows, embedded in the binary so any checkout can drive a real Chrome page via a chrome_cdp capability. Provides deterministic navigation wait (`_wait_loaded` URL polling — the engine's wait_ready skips the URL check and can return on the pre-navigation about:blank target, racing the real navigation commit), best-effort page release, a fresh-page retry wrapper, arbitrary-JS evaluation, an htmx wait, and a generic assert. No site-specific logic: consumers pass url/expression/checks via `with` and keep their own assertions.
